_comment: The recognition table. parser.py loads this and keeps no verb list of its own. Generated by tests/spec/generate_recognition.py.

env_reasons.source: changes where {tool} downloads packages from. Package Guard reviews packages from the default registry only: run the command without it, and do not set it another way (export, a config file, a shell startup file)
env_reasons.network: routes {tool}'s downloads through a mirror, proxy or other TLS trust, so the files may not be the ones Package Guard reviewed: run the command without it
env_reasons.requirements: adds requirements {tool} would resolve outside the reviewed set: run the command without it and name each package on the command line
env_reasons.retarget: points {tool} at another project or install location than the one Package Guard reads: run the command without it from the project directory
env_reasons.integrity: turns off a check {tool} or Package Guard relies on: run the command without it
env_reasons.unknown: is not on Package Guard's list of known-safe {tool} settings; run the command without it, or ask the user
env_reasons.path: must be a literal absolute path, such as {name}=/home/agent/venvs/app: no variable, `~`, glob or `..`, and not inside .claude/
env_reasons.config: moves the configuration files {tool} reads, which can name another registry, index or proxy than the ones Package Guard checked: run the command without it

installers.unknown_hint: use pnpm run <script> or pnpm exec <bin>

fetch.note: downloads every locked package into the store

dedupe.note: re-resolves the tree from the registry

remove.note: inert unless a source or target flag is present (Q12)

deploy.note: installs into a directory reconciliation never reads

rebuild.note: re-runs install scripts of installed packages

pack.note: runs the root prepack and prepare scripts

store.note: store path|status only; add fetches, prune deletes

run.note: runs a project script; inert like npm run, plus the config checks (RunScope)

exec.note: runs a binary of the project's node_modules/.bin; fetches nothing (pnpm dlx fetches)

remove.note: inert unless a source or target flag is present (Q12)

create.note: runs create-* packages and template hooks

run.note: with no node_modules Bun installs what it imports at run time; the hook refuses that (RunScope.autoinstall)

pack.note: runs the root prepack and prepare scripts

up.note: Berry: re-resolves dependencies from the registry

upgrade.note: Classic: one named package at an exact version; bare upgrade is refused

global.note: Classic: a global install escapes the project tree

list.note: Classic read-only verb; on Berry it would run a script

cache.note: Classic: only cache dir and cache list read

policies.note: Classic self-update downloads a different yarn

version.note: Classic: bumps package.json and runs version scripts

remove.note: inert unless a source or target flag is present (Q12)

npm.note: only npm info and npm audit are read-only

pack.note: runs the root prepack and prepare scripts

plugin.note: plugins are code that runs inside yarn

run.note: runs a project script; the hook requires an up-to-date node_modules install state

sync.note: installs the locked project including dev groups

build.note: fetches build-system.requires and runs the backend

version.note: a new value or --bump re-locks and syncs the project; bare, --dry-run, --frozen and --no-sync install nothing

venv.note: --seed installs pip from the index uv is given; an index, find-links or mirror flag is refused, a plain venv is not

upgrade.note: fetches a newer version of an installed tool

installers.note: _executable folds pip3 and pip3.12 to pip

config.note: only setting an index key is refused

foreign._comment: Recognised and denied. CLAUDE.md forbids these outright, so the parser must see them: recognising and denying turns silence into a visible refusal without any registry or manifest logic. Full support is out of scope.
